# Gîte de la Calade

> Holiday home (gîte) for up to 4 guests (6 with extra beds) with a shared 10 × 5 m pool, in the village of Caussiniojouls, Hérault, Occitanie, southern France. Stone house of 88 m² with two bedrooms, garden and views over the vineyards to the Mediterranean. Approved by Gîtes de France (ref. 34G062), rated 5/5 by guests. Host: Sibylle, who speaks German, French and English. Bookings currently go through Gîtes de France.

## Key facts

- Location: 1 Rue de la Calade, 34600 Caussiniojouls, France (GPS 43.5506, 3.1538), north of Béziers, on the edge of the Haut-Languedoc regional nature park
- Capacity: 4 guests; 2 extra beds, a cot and a high chair on request
- Size: 88 m² on two floors; ground floor air-conditioned
- Price: from €805 per week; deposit €200
- Check-in from 4 pm, check-out by 10 am
- Included: bed linen, towels, table linen, electricity, heating, Wi-Fi, final cleaning
- Pets: not allowed
- Parking: private parking in front of the house
- Extras on request: breakfast or dinner with the host (extra cost)

## The house

- Living room: sofas in front of an old stone wall, projector with films
- Kitchen: open kitchen with oven, two hobs, kettle, toaster, Italian coffee maker
- Shower room: walk-in shower, washbasin, WC (ground floor)
- Bedroom 1 (upstairs): 20 m², double bed 160 × 200 cm, reading corner
- Bedroom 2 (upstairs): 20 m², four-poster bed 180 × 200 cm, antique writing desk

## Garden and pool

- Pool 10 × 5 m, water depth 1–2.5 m, shared with the host
- Shady spot under a tree in front of the house
- Covered terrace with a large table and a barbecue

## Surroundings (distances from the house)

- On site: walking and long-distance hiking trails; a cycle path passes the house
- 0.1 km: restaurant and vineyard
- 0.2 km: forest
- 5 km: shops, tennis
- 10 km: horse riding, doctor
- 15 km: Bédarieux train station, cinema, museums
- 40 km: Mediterranean beaches
- About 45 km: Béziers Cap d'Agde airport
- Nearby: Lac du Salagou, Mourèze, Gorges d'Héric, Olargues, Pézenas, Béziers, Étang de Thau; river swimming, climbing, canyoning, treetop trails, local wines
